name: Engineering
about: A wide range of engineering programs, from aerospace and mechanical to software, electrical and civil, with hands-on design of aircraft, vehicles, machinery, software and medical systems, and an optional co-op.

name: Journalism
about: A Bachelor of Journalism program whose storytelling skills lead into news careers and other fields, with a Health Sciences concentration option. Carleton describes it as internationally renowned and as having produced many top journalists.

name: Public Affairs and Policy Management
about: Combines public policy with political science, economics, law and history to understand what governments do, why they do it and how policy can be improved, in the national capital.

name: Commerce (John Molson School of Business)
about: A business degree at the AACSB-accredited John Molson School with options from accountancy and finance to business analytics and supply chain, co-op options, and international exchanges, in downtown Montreal.

name: Film Production
about: A competitive program in which you work on the making of a film every year, with hands-on technical training and film history and theory, studios from analog to digital, and Montreal's film industry on the doorstep.

name: Marine Biology
about: Study marine animals and plants from the shore and the water, with a Blue Planet course in year 2, marine ecology and mammalogy later, and a new on-campus marine biodiversity centre. Optional Science Co-op with three work terms.

name: Computer Science
about: Software development, algorithms, networking and graphics, with six customizable majors from Cybersecurity and AI to Human-Computer Interaction, and optional paid co-op of up to 12 months.

name: Bio-Medical Science
about: A broad foundation in human and animal health, from physiology and anatomy to immunology and pathology, with hands-on dissection courses. It meets the entry requirements of Ontario medical and veterinary schools.

name: Honours Agriculture
about: A core of agriculture and food science combined with courses in business, animals, plants and the environment, chosen with a faculty advisor. The co-op route takes five years with four paid work terms.

name: Hospitality and Tourism Management
about: A business degree for hotels, events, resorts, restaurants and tourism, with a food lab, case competitions and an optional 12-month co-op. In second year you pick an emphasis such as marketing or beverage management.

name: Engineering
about: A common first year in maths and science, then Biosystems, Civil, Computer, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, with smaller classes and an optional paid Co-op and Industrial Internship Program.

name: Computer Science
about: A mathematically rich, theory-based degree in how computers work and carry out tasks in software, with research labs from robotics to bioinformatics and an optional Science Co-op.

name: Mechanical Engineering
about: Design, build and operate mechanical systems, from bicycles to spacecraft, with three areas of specialization: Design, Aeronautics and Mechatronics. Prepares for aerospace, energy, manufacturing and robotics work.

name: Bachelor of Commerce (Desautels Faculty of Management)
about: A management degree that pairs a disciplinary foundation with room to personalise your courses, taught by an international faculty. The 120-credit programme shortens when IB advanced standing is granted.

name: Engineering
about: A shared Level 1 Engineering year of project-based, hands-on classes, then 11 disciplines from Chemical to Software, with flexible co-op terms. Start in the Discovery Track to explore, or apply straight to a discipline.

name: Honours Health Sciences
about: An interdisciplinary study of health and illness from biological, behavioural and population perspectives, built around Inquiry courses in small groups, with a research project or thesis in the final year.

name: Commerce
about: A four-year honours business degree at the Smith School of Business with eleven fields of study, from accounting and finance to digital technology, plus exchange options in 120+ locations and structured career support.

name: Engineering
about: Start in a shared General First Year with a guaranteed choice among 10 disciplines, or apply Direct Entry to a program such as Civil, Electrical or Mechatronics and Robotics. Optional 12 to 16 month paid internships.

name: Computing Science
about: Computing problems from networks to artificial intelligence to complexity theory, with flexibility in how you build the degree. An optional co-op lets you graduate with a Co-op designation after three work terms.

name: Interactive Arts and Technology
about: An interdisciplinary Surrey-campus program where technologists, artists, designers and theorists work together, with three areas of focus: Design, Interactive Systems and Media Arts.

name: Mechatronics Engineering
about: Combine mechanical, electronic and computer engineering to design intelligent, automated systems: robotics, programming, circuits and microcontrollers, finishing with a team capstone project presented to industry experts.

name: Journalism
about: Build journalistic techniques from the first day in industry-grade newsrooms, with multimedia reporting, tools for spotting misinformation and an internship available, in one of North America's large media hubs.

name: Computer Science (St. George)
about: Computer Science in the Faculty of Arts & Science at the downtown St. George campus, as a Major or Specialist (BCS) or a Minor within an HBSc, with work-integrated learning available.

name: Engineering Science
about: Two foundation years in engineering, maths, science, computing and design, then eight majors for the last two years. Research runs through the degree, in contrast to the eight direct-entry engineering disciplines.

name: Computing Science
about: A customizable Science degree with strengths in artificial intelligence, machine learning, robotics, games and databases, as a major or honors, with a minor or double major from more than 60 subjects.

name: Engineering
about: Direct entry from school into a general first-year program, after which you apply to your specialization. Five departments: Biomedical, Mechanical, Electrical and Computer, Chemical and Materials, Civil and Environmental; co-op is available.

name: Computer Science (BSc, Vancouver)
about: A four-year Science degree covering databases, operating systems, software engineering, security and web development, with honours and optional paid co-op. Majors can now take an Artificial Intelligence option.

name: Commerce (Sauder School of Business)
about: A four-year business degree on the Vancouver campus with ten specializations, from accounting and finance to marketing and real estate, and an optional co-op that alternates study with paid work terms.

name: Engineering (common first year)
about: Everyone starts with the same 10 design, maths, science and engineering courses in Schulich School of Engineering, then ranks majors in winter term; first choice of program is guaranteed if you complete all ten. Paid career practicum and internship options.

name: Commerce (Haskayne School of Business)
about: A four-year business degree entered directly from school, with an optional Co-operative Education stream, an Honours research option and more than 30 exchange partners. Haskayne has held AACSB accreditation since 1985.

name: Commerce (Telfer School of Management)
about: A management degree at the Telfer School in downtown Ottawa, with options aligned to accounting, finance, HR and analytics designations, and a co-op route. Streams run in English, French or French immersion.

name: Political Science
about: Four subfields at the School of Political Studies: political thought, Canadian and Quebec politics, comparative politics, and international relations. Offered in English and French, with a co-op placing students with federal employers in the capital.

name: Engineering
about: A redesigned first year with hands-on courses and tutorials in place of final exams, then one of eight accredited majors from chemical and civil to engineering physics. An optional co-op adds 4 to 20 months of paid work.

name: Agriculture and Bioresources
about: Degrees in agriculture, agribusiness, animal bioscience and food, with majors from crop science and agronomy to horticulture. The college has taught since 1912 and also offers two years of pre-veterinary study.

name: Engineering
about: A general first year of engineering courses, then you declare biomedical, civil, computer, electrical, mechanical or software engineering. Paid four-month co-op terms with employers are part of UVic's engineering offer.

name: Computer Science
about: A hands-on, collaborative degree in how systems work and software is built, with combined options such as Data Science, Mathematics, Music or Health Information Science, and co-op work terms.

name: Computer Science
about: Learn how software is designed and built, with more than 70 courses from AI and data science to cybersecurity. No programming background is assumed, and co-op can add up to two years of paid work.

name: Software Engineering
about: An engineering degree in software design, algorithms, digital hardware and human-computer interfaces, offered with the Faculty of Mathematics. It is co-op only, alternating study with paid work terms.

name: Medical Sciences
about: A first-entry science route through the Faculty of Science into the Bachelor of Medical Sciences, taught with the Schulich School of Medicine & Dentistry. Complete Medical Sciences 1 and 2 and Year 3 BMSc is assured.

name: Engineering
about: A common first year for all engineering students, then you rank your choice of discipline, from Civil and Mechanical to Software and Mechatronic Systems. Co-op and internship options, plus combined degrees with business or law.

name: Engineering
about: A common first year in applied maths, physical sciences, programming and engineering, then civil, computer, electrical, mechanical, mechatronics, software or space engineering. Co-op and project-based learning; first year can be at the Markham campus.

name: Business Administration (BBA)
about: The four-year Bachelor of Business Administration at the Schulich School of Business, with direct entry from school, small tutorials, case-competition preparation and exchanges at 60+ partner schools.

name: Computer Science
about: Programming, algorithms, data structures and systems taught through hands-on labs, team projects and supervised work experience at the Lassonde School of Engineering, with AI reshaping the field.

name: Fashion Studies
about: Fashion studied as a global cultural phenomenon and an industry, in Paris: key concepts, histories and current debates, with research methods and visual and material analysis, in a liberal arts setting.

name: International & Comparative Politics
about: How ideas and resources move across nations: international relations theory, international political economy, international law, comparative politics and political philosophy, with research methods and rigorous argument.

name: Computer Science
about: Computational and quantitative methods applied across subjects, plus the theory behind computing and software: Java programming, discrete mathematics and data science, with work in the Technology and Cognition Lab.

name: Business Management Track
about: A flexible four-year management degree taught in English or French from the first year, with a sector specialisation, internships and time abroad.

name: Global Business Track
about: Year 1 at EDHEC in Nice, year 2 at UCLA Extension in Los Angeles and year 3 at Nanyang Technological University in Singapore, with long internships; taught in English.

name: International Business Analytics and Management BSc
about: A double degree with King's Business School, taught entirely in English: business analytics and international management, studied in London and in Lille.

name: Global BBA
about: A four-year management degree on the Lyon campus with an English track, exchanges and double-degree options, and up to 75% of the time abroad; work-study possible in year 4.

name: BSc in Data Science for Responsible Business
about: Run with the engineering school Centrale Lyon and taught in English: maths, programming and data science with responsible AI and business, on both Lyon campuses.

name: Bachelor in Management (BSc)
about: Management, economics and law with liberal arts and languages, studied on three ESCP campuses in three countries; taught in English with some classes in French.

name: Bachelor in Management, Science & Technology (BSc)
about: New from September 2027: management combined with maths, computer science and AI, physics, chemistry and life sciences, for students who want to keep science and business open; taught in English.

name: Bachelor in Politics, Economics & Management
about: Four-year dual degree with Sciences Po, taught in English: a Sciences Po Bachelor of Arts and ESCP's BSc in Management, joining social sciences with management.

name: Global BBA
about: A four-year management degree with 10 to 12 months of internships and at least six months abroad at a partner university; the English track starts in Cergy (or Singapore).

name: BSc in Artificial Intelligence, Data & Management Sciences
about: Run jointly with the engineering school CentraleSupélec: mathematical modelling, data science and computer science with a generalist base in management, taught 100% in English, with 9 months of internships.

name: Bachelor of Science
about: A demanding, research-led science degree taught entirely in English: a broad first year, then a double major in Mathematics with Physics, Computer Science or Economics, ending in a research thesis.

name: International Bachelor of Science in AI
about: Mathematics, algorithms and programming, then machine learning, vision, language processing and robotics, with research internships in PSL labs; all classes in English, in central Paris.

name: International Bachelor of Environmentally Engaged Engineering
about: New in 2026 from Mines Paris-PSL and Chimie Paris-PSL: project-based general engineering for energy, water, health, climate and cities, with data science throughout; taught in English.

name: Bachelor of Arts, Asia-Pacific minor (Le Havre)
about: Law, economics, history, political science and sociology, with a minor on Asia and the Pacific; the third year is spent abroad.

name: Bachelor of Arts, Mediterranean and Middle East minor (Menton)
about: Law, economics, history, political science and sociology, with a minor on the Mediterranean and the Middle East; the third year is spent abroad.

name: Bachelor of Arts, North America minor or Africa minor (English track) (Reims)
about: Law, economics, history, political science and sociology, with a minor on North America or the English track of the Africa minor; the third year is spent abroad.

name: Dual BA with Keio University
about: Two years on the Le Havre campus (Asia-Pacific minor), then two years in Keio's economics department in Tokyo; taught entirely in English.

name: Dual BA with the University of Hong Kong
about: Two years at an English-track Sciences Po campus in France, then two years at the University of Hong Kong, ending with a bachelor's degree from each.

name: Dual bachelor's in Politics, Economics & Management with ESCP
about: Two years at Sciences Po Reims (North America minor), then a year at ESCP London and a year on another ESCP campus; taught entirely in English.

name: Dual BA with Columbia University
about: Two years at an English-track Sciences Po campus in France, then two years at Columbia University in New York, ending with a bachelor's degree from each.

name: Dual BA with the National University of Singapore
about: Two years at an English-track Sciences Po campus in France, then two years at NUS in Singapore, ending with a bachelor's degree from each.

name: Dual BA with the University of British Columbia
about: Two years at an English-track Sciences Po campus in France, then two years at UBC in Vancouver, ending with a bachelor's degree from each.

name: Dual BA with UC Berkeley
about: Two years at an English-track Sciences Po campus in France, then two years at UC Berkeley's College of Letters and Science, ending with a bachelor's degree from each.

name: Dual BA with the University of Sydney
about: Two years at an English-track Sciences Po campus in France, then two years at the University of Sydney, ending with a bachelor's degree from each.

name: Bachelor of Veterinary Medicine
about: A six-year veterinary degree developed with Cornell University's College of Veterinary Medicine, accredited by both the RCVS and the Australasian Veterinary Boards Council, so graduates can register in Hong Kong, the UK, Australia and New Zealand.

name: BSc Data Science
about: A four-year degree in data science covering statistics, data mining, machine learning and computing tools, with advanced study in artificial intelligence, social media analytics or statistical learning.

name: BA Creative Media
about: A School of Creative Media major that joins critical study and creative practice across photography, computational art, games and interactive media, sound, animation and film.

name: Medicine (MBChB)
credential: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery
about: Six years in a personalised medical curriculum with mentoring, early clinical teaching and a choice of enrichment tracks; a one-year hospital internship in Hong Kong follows before you register as a doctor.

name: Computer Science and Engineering
about: One department-based entry into the Department of Computer Science and Engineering; after year one you declare Computer Science (BSc, software and AI) or Computer Engineering (BEng, hardware and embedded systems).

name: Integrated BBA Programme
about: A broad business degree where you build your own path from nine concentrations such as finance, marketing and business analytics, with exchange, mentoring and internship options and double-degree routes.

name: Psychology
about: A psychology degree with a foundation, core and elective structure, areas of concentration and an internship; qualifying graduates can apply for membership of the Hong Kong Psychological Society.

name: AI and Educational Technology
about: A four-year degree on artificial intelligence and its use in education and other industries, offered by the Department of Mathematics and Information Technology and mainly taught in English.

name: Integrated Environmental Management
about: A multidisciplinary degree on environmental management and sustainability: management systems, risk and impact assessment, pollution control and environmental regulation. All major courses are taught in English.

name: Personal Finance
about: A degree focused on personal financial advising and wealth management, covering taxation, credit management, retirement and estate planning, plus fintech, risk management and sustainable finance. Taught in English.

name: Special Education
about: A degree for students who want to support people with special needs, leading to careers in education and human services. The programme is mainly conducted in English.

name: Music
about: Four years of professional training in musical performance or composition, with music history and theory alongside, for school leavers who want a career in music; places in some majors are limited and vary year to year.

name: Dance
about: A four-year dance degree built on three streams and an east-west outlook, preparing you for company work as well as freelance and multiple-portfolio careers with room for independence and versatility.

name: Theatre and Entertainment Arts
about: A four-year degree with majors and specialisations such as media design and technology, technical production and management, and set and costume design, taught through scenic construction, portfolio seminars and productions.

name: Communication (Journalism, PR and Advertising)
about: One broad-based entry into two majors, Journalism and Digital Media or Public Relations and Advertising. The journalism side offers Chinese, international, broadcast and financial specialisms, plus a data and media concentration.

name: Chinese Medicine and Biomedical Science
credential: Bachelor of Chinese Medicine and BSc
about: A six-year double degree combining Chinese medicine, biomedical and clinical Western medicine and university-wide courses, with a 15-month internship and an honours project. Some courses are taught in Putonghua or Cantonese.

name: Bachelor of Arts (Hons) in Film and Television
about: A four-year film and television degree in the School of Creative Arts with a small first-year intake of 18 students; classes are taught in English.

name: Cyber and Computer Security
about: A computing degree on cyber security that builds knowledge of hardware, software, infrastructure and professional practice; the page states English as the language of instruction.

name: Electronic and Computer Engineering
about: An engineering degree with core courses in electronic and computer engineering, then specialisation in mobile and wireless networks, signal processing, biomedical technologies, digital multimedia or software; taught in English.

name: Bachelor of Dental Surgery
about: Six years to become a dentist, mostly in clinics and the dental teaching hospital in Hong Kong, with hands-on training in medical and surgical settings across the city. The degree is registrable with the Dental Council of Hong Kong.

name: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery
credential: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery
about: Six years of medicine built on small-group problem-based tutorials, early clinical exposure and community placements in clinics, hospices and maternal and child health services, ending in an assistant internship.

name: Bachelor of Science in Surveying
about: Four years across land development: land administration, property development, construction management, real estate finance, facility management and conservation, with studio work and the chance of an internship or a semester of exchange.

name: Computer Science
about: Computer science taught by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering: programming, algorithms, operating systems and software engineering, then electives in AI, security, big data and more. A BEng in Artificial Intelligence is the sister major.

name: Quantitative Finance
about: A finance degree built on maths and statistics: derivative securities, investment analysis, portfolio management, quantitative trading and risk management, with one or two semesters of full-time internships at financial firms common.

name: Business and Management
about: Enter the business school without a major: three terms of broad business foundations, then a choice from nine BBA majors and more. Around 70% of students add a second major or minor, and extended majors in AI, arts or sustainability exist.

name: Actuarial Studies and Insurance
about: An actuarial degree that combines actuarial science with business and insurance education, building data analytics, investment and financial analysis skills and preparing you for professional exams along the way.

name: Animation and Digital Arts
about: A creative-arts degree with equal weight on art history and theory and on animation workshops, with concentrations in Digital Animation and in Arts and Technology; it started in 2019/20.

name: Hotel and Tourism Management
about: One scheme with a shared first year, then a choice of Hotel Management, Smart Tourism and Hospitality, or Event and Experience Management, with optional AI and data or innovation secondary majors and a 2+2 option in Vienna or Paris.

name: Design
about: A four-year design scheme: a common foundation year, a cluster year in communication, immersive media and games, environment, product experience or service design, then one of nine specialisms, with exchange, study trips and internships.

name: Optometry
about: Five years of general education and basic science, then optometric clinical techniques and five semesters of supervised clinical training with real patients, plus a final project in years four and five.
